Here are the extension installation instructions from the README.md:
# Installation

The extensions can only be loaded in development mode as they are not uploaded
to the extension stores (Mozilla Addons/Chrome Webstore).

- Chrome:
 - Go to extensions page, and turn the `Developer Mode` switch on.
 - Drag and drop `<extension-name>.crx` into the extensions page.
 - If the drag and drop seem to be not working:
 - I experienced this issue on Linux (Gnome Wayland).
 - Try dragging it onto the page, if no overlay appears, drop it back where you dragged it from.
 - Repeat this a few times. Should get it working after 2-3 tries.
 - If you drop without the overlay visible, the file will get downloaded instead of getting installed.

A list of issues/requests from the users:

We improved the following things as per user feedback

- UI/UX
 * Added separators for identifying different UTxOs faster
 * Auto activate accounts and network backends when added when there are no other accounts or network backends.

- Feature: Custom endpoint support for blockfrost.

Previously we only supported the default blockfrost instance.
- Bug fix: Some dApps treat the API object as a bag of functions, which by the spec can be any object. This causes SundaeSwap and possibly more dApps to hang. We changed our API object to be a bag of functions instead of a class instance.
- Bug fix: Sync the overrides in `getUtxos()` with the `getBalance()` call.

dApps get token balances through either the `getUtxo()` call and summing the token balance themselves or using the `getBalance()` call to have the wallet calculate them.

Our UI supports mocking the token balances through the UTxO list, but it was not reflected in the `getBalance()`. The `getBalance()` call is now changed to be the sum of balances from the `getUtxos()` call, unless separately overriden.
